reviews.title: Great fans
reviews.comment: The fans work great and are programmable with Signal RGB. After adding three fans, my case is much cooler.
reviews.author: TechieGuy

reviews.title: Affordable Top Quality PC Case Fans
reviews.comment:
Excellent fans. You won't be disappointed. Couple these fans with an ARGB controller like the Thermaltake TT Sync or the Corsair Commander and you can easily manage all of the ARGB fans and lighting for the entire PC especially if you have limited ARGB connectors on your motherboard.
These fans run quiet with vibrant colors and get the job done to keep you PC running cool and efficient.
reviews.author: Wesdon Arnold

reviews.title: Only needed one.
reviews.comment: The fan was great, but I only needed one. Couldn't buy only one so I got the pack of three. Maybe I'll need the others at some point but I doubt it. The price was good so buying one elsewhere would not have been worth the effort. The fan itself, though, is excellent.
